items.informal_name: Evaluation of Taylor Polynomial within a Set
items.type: {E : Type u_2} → [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] → [NormedSpace ℝ E] → (ℝ → E) → ℕ → Set ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → E
items.informal_description: The function evaluates the Taylor polynomial of degree $n$ of a real function $f : \mathbb{R} \to E$, centered at $x_0$ and restricted to the subset $s \subseteq \mathbb{R}$, at the point $x$. Here, $E$ is a real normed vector space. The result is an element of $E$ obtained by evaluating the polynomial approximation of $f$ constructed using $n$ terms within the specified domain $s$.

items.type:
{E : Type u_2} →
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] → [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] → (ℝ → E) → ℕ → Set ℝ → ℝ → PolynomialModule ℝ E
items.informal_description: For a function $ f : \mathbb{R} \to E $, natural number $ n $, subset $ s \subseteq \mathbb{R} $, and point $ x_0 \in \mathbb{R} $, the Taylor polynomial of degree $ n $ within $ s $ at $ x_0 $ is defined as the finite sum $ \sum_{k=0}^n \left(\frac{f^{(k)}(x_0)}{k!} \cdot (X - x_0)^k\right) $, where each coefficient $ \frac{f^{(k)}(x_0)}{k!} $ is computed using the $ k $-th iterated derivative of $ f $ restricted to $ s $. This represents the polynomial approximation of $ f $ near $ x_0 $ within the domain $ s $.

items.informal_name: Coefficient of Taylor Expansion at $ r $: $ \text{coeff}_n(f(X + r)) = D^{(n)}f(r) $
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (r : R) (f : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ),
  ((Polynomial.taylor r) f).coeff n = Polynomial.eval r ((Polynomial.hasseDeriv n) f)
items.informal_description: For any polynomial $ f $ over a semiring $ R $, natural number $ n $, and element $ r \in R $, the coefficient of $ X^n $ in the Taylor expansion $ f(X + r) $ equals the evaluation of the $ n $-th Hasse derivative of $ f $ at $ r $. The Hasse derivative $ D^{(n)} $ scales monomials $ a_i X^i $ by $ \binom{i}{n} a_i X^{i - n} $.

items.informal_name: Hasse Derivative of Order k on Polynomial Ring
items.type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : Semiring R] → ℕ → Polynomial R →ₗ[R] Polynomial R
items.informal_description: For a semiring $ R $, the Hasse derivative of order $ k $ is an $ R $-linear map $ D^{(k)} : R[X] 	o R[X] $ defined by $ D^{(k)}(a_i X^i) =  inom{i}{k} a_i X^{i - k} $ on monomials and extended linearly. This operation generalizes the usual derivative by scaling each coefficient $ a_i $ by the binomial coefficient $  inom{i}{k} $ and reducing the degree by $ k $.

items.informal_name: Hasse Derivative of Order k Applied to a Polynomial
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (k : ℕ) (f : Polynomial R),
  (Polynomial.hasseDeriv k) f = f.sum fun i r => (Polynomial.monomial (i - k)) (↑(i.choose k) * r)
items.informal_description: For a semiring $ R $ and a polynomial $ f \in R[X] $, the Hasse derivative of order $ k $ applied to $ f $ is given by $ D^{(k)}(f) = \sum_{i} \binom{i}{k} \cdot a_i \cdot X^{i - k} $, where $ a_i $ is the coefficient of $ X^i $ in $ f $. This expression sums over all monomials in $ f $, scaling each by the binomial coefficient $ \binom{i}{k} $ and reducing the exponent by $ k $.

items.informal_name: Evaluation of Expanded Multivariate Polynomial Equals Evaluation with Pth Power Function
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : ℕ) {A : Type u_5} [inst_1 : CommSemiring A]
  [inst_2 : Algebra R A] (f : σ → A) (φ : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (MvPolynomial.aeval f) ((MvPolynomial.expand p) φ) = (MvPolynomial.aeval (f ^ p)) φ
items.informal_description: For any commutative semiring $A$ with an $R$-algebra structure, function $f : \sigma \to A$, and polynomial $\varphi \in R[\sigma]$, the evaluation of the expanded polynomial $\text{expand}_p(\varphi)$ using $f$ equals the evaluation of $\varphi$ using the function $f^p$ that maps each $x \in \sigma$ to $f(x)^p$. Symbolically: $\text{aeval}_f(\text{expand}_p(\varphi)) = \text{aeval}_{f^p}(\varphi)$.

items.informal_name: Composition of Evaluation and Expansion Homomorphisms Equals Evaluation of p-th Power
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : ℕ) {A : Type u_5} [inst_1 : CommSemiring A]
  [inst_2 : Algebra R A] (f : σ → A), (MvPolynomial.aeval f).comp (MvPolynomial.expand p) = MvPolynomial.aeval (f ^ p)
items.informal_description: For any commutative semiring $A$ with an $R$-algebra structure and any function $f : \sigma \to A$, the composition of the algebra homomorphism $\text{aeval}(f)$ with the expansion homomorphism $\text{expand}(p)$ equals the algebra homomorphism $\text{aeval}(f^p)$, where $f^p$ denotes the function mapping each variable to its $p$-th power under the algebra structure.

items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} {S : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommSemiring S] (p : ℕ) (f : R →+* S)
  (g : σ → S) (φ : MvPolynomial σ R),
  MvPolynomial.eval₂ f g ((MvPolynomial.expand p) φ) = MvPolynomial.eval₂ f (g ^ p) φ
items.informal_description: For any commutative semiring homomorphism $ f : R \to S $, variable assignment $ g : \sigma \to S $, polynomial $ \varphi \in R[\sigma] $, and natural number $ p $, evaluating the expanded polynomial $ \text{expand}_p(\varphi) $ using $ f $ and $ g $ is equivalent to evaluating $ \varphi $ using $ f $ and the $ p $-th power of $ g $, i.e., $ \text{eval}_2(f, g)(\text{expand}_p(\varphi)) = \text{eval}_2(f, g^p)(\varphi) $.

items.informal_name: Evaluation of Expanded Polynomial Equals Evaluation with Variables Raised to p-th Power
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : ℕ) (f : σ → R) (φ : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (MvPolynomial.eval f) ((MvPolynomial.expand p) φ) = (MvPolynomial.eval (f ^ p)) φ
items.informal_description: For any commutative semiring $ R $, type $ \sigma $, natural number $ p $, function $ f : \sigma \to R $, and polynomial $ \varphi \in R[\sigma] $, the evaluation of the expanded polynomial $ \text{expand}_p(\varphi) $ at $ f $ is equal to the evaluation of $ \varphi $ at the function $ f^p $, where $ f^p $ denotes the function mapping each $ \sigma $ to $ f(\sigma)^p $. This establishes that expanding a multivariate polynomial by raising variables to the $ p $-th power and then evaluating is equivalent to evaluating the original polynomial with each variable's value raised to the $ p $-th power.

items.informal_name: Evaluation of Multivariate Polynomial with Coefficient and Variable Maps
items.type:
{R : Type u} →
  {S₁ : Type v} →
    {σ : Type u_1} →
      [inst : CommSemiring R] → [inst_1 : CommSemiring S₁] → (R →+* S₁) → (σ → S₁) → MvPolynomial σ R → S₁
items.informal_description: The evaluation of a multivariate polynomial $ p $ in variables $ \sigma $ with coefficients in a commutative semiring $ R $, where coefficients are mapped via $ f : R \to S_1 $ and variables are mapped via $ g : \sigma \to S_1 $. For each monomial term $ a \cdot \prod_{n \in \sigma} X_n^{e_n} $, the evaluation computes $ f(a) \cdot \prod_{n \in \sigma} g(n)^{e_n} $, and sums these contributions over all terms of the polynomial.

items.name: Polynomial.sum_taylor_eq
items.type: {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (f : Polynomial R) (r : R) : (((Polynomial.taylor r) f).sum fun i a => Polynomial.C a * (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C r) ^ i) = f

items.name: MvPolynomial.aeval_sum
items.type: {R : Type u} {S₁ : Type v} {σ : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S₁] [Algebra R S₁] (f : σ → S₁) {ι : Type u_2} (s : Finset ι) (φ : ι → MvPolynomial σ R) : (MvPolynomial.aeval f) (∑ i ∈ s, φ i) = ∑ i ∈ s, (MvPolynomial.aeval f) (φ i)

items.name: MvPolynomial.aeval_sumElim
items.type: {R : Type u} [CommSemiring R] {S : Type u_2} {T : Type u_3} [CommSemiring S] [Algebra R S] [CommSemiring T] [Algebra R T] [Algebra S T] [IsScalarTower R S T] {σ : Type u_4} {τ : Type u_5} (p : MvPolynomial (σ ⊕ τ) R) (f : τ → S) (g : σ → T) : (MvPolynomial.aeval (Sum.elim g (⇑(algebraMap S T) ∘ f))) p = (MvPolynomial.aeval g) ((MvPolynomial.aeval (Sum.elim MvPolynomial.X (⇑MvPolynomial.C ∘ f))) p)

items.name: Algebra.Generators.ofComp_toAlgHom_monomial_sumElim
items.type: {R : Type u} {S : Type v} {ι : Type w} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] {ι' : Type u_3} {T : Type u_7} [CommRing T] [Algebra R T] [Algebra S T] [IsScalarTower R S T] (Q : Algebra.Generators S T ι') (P : Algebra.Generators R S ι) (v₁ : ι' →₀ ℕ) (v₂ : ι →₀ ℕ) (a : R) : (Q.ofComp P).toAlgHom ((MvPolynomial.monomial (v₁.sumElim v₂)) a) = (MvPolynomial.monomial v₁) ((MvPolynomial.aeval P.val) ((MvPolynomial.monomial v₂) a))

items.name: MvPolynomial.aeval_sumElim_pderiv_inl
items.type: {R : Type u} {σ : Type v} [CommSemiring R] {S : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] (p : MvPolynomial (σ ⊕ τ) R) (f : τ → S) (j : σ) : (MvPolynomial.aeval (Sum.elim MvPolynomial.X (⇑MvPolynomial.C ∘ f))) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inl j)) p) = (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) ((MvPolynomial.aeval (Sum.elim MvPolynomial.X (⇑MvPolynomial.C ∘ f))) p)

∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (r : R) (f : Polynomial R) (s : R),
  Polynomial.eval (s - r) ((Polynomial.taylor r) f) = Polynomial.eval s f

items.name: Polynomial.taylor_eval

items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S₁ : Type v} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommSemiring S₁] [inst_2 : Fintype σ]
  (g : R →+* S₁) (X : σ → S₁) (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  MvPolynomial.eval₂ g X f = ∑ d ∈ f.support, g (MvPolynomial.coeff d f) * ∏ i, X i ^ d i
